text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff... puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, look, it's Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. Still pint-sized as ever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you two...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Look at that uniform... So you
got into Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a little hard,
Taishin? Trying to be a
Tracen runner I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, we're no Umamusume, but I bet
we could win against you!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, guess we're good enough for Tracen
too.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Geez, still making that same sour face.
What a loser. Let's get outta
here.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Laters. ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishiiin! We're back! And we brought the
goods—TAIYAKI!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? You in a bad mood?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's probably because you took so long
shopping, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But Taishin's always like,
"I don't care. Get
anything." Between crepes
and ice cream, I
didn't know what to choose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But look, I got you the super-duper size,
so you can get big and
strong!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: S-super-duper?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No worries if you can't finish the whole
thing—we'll help out! Let's sit
down over
there and eat.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on,
they'll get cold if we don't hurry!
Pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really... Let's go, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: 'Kay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right, one more lap!

Only a few days remain before the Satsuki
Sho.

Winning Ticket is entering the final stage
of her training. Today, I'm
having her do
runs outside the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm so full of energy!
Let's get this extra
training going!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All riiight! Time to get fired UP!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Winning Ticket and her trainer. I
take it you're about to start
training.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Sure are. Why, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, a group of reporters have
gathered in front of the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of asking them to leave so
they don't interfere with
training. There
are only a few days left until the Satsuki
Sho, after all.

She's right. With so little time left, we
should be getting in as much
training as
possible. It'd be best if they left.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let me talk to them!
No way could I Iet
down any fans or
reporters!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh? But your training...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! I'm not trying to skip it or
anything. I'm still gonna do exactly
as we
planned!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So! Looks like I'll be at it until curfew!
You'll stick with me the whole
time, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, let's go see those reporters then!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Winning Ticket's here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ticket! Are you taking questions?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! No need to push. I'll answer
everyone's questions!

With the Satsuki Sho so close, Winning
Ticket is drawing more
attention from the
public eye.

Feeling it her duty, she answers all the
questions as best she can.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket! How's your training
coming along?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Um...
It's really great! I can tell I'm getting
better each day!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried about your two rivals
running in the same race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm totally excited to race with
them! And not just in the
Satsuki Sho, but
in the Derby too!

As the gracious racer attends to the swarm
of journalists, Narita
Taishin walks out of
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You look like you're in a jam.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taishin! Hehe... You know me,
couldn't refuse.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin!
Regarding your first race of
the Classics, will you—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I've got training. Later, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh... O-okay.

Narita Taishin dodges the sudden question
and briskly walks away.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide avoided us just before too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: She did?

I guess Ticket's rivals are too focused on
training for the upcoming
Satsuki Sho.

While watching her little press event,
I try
to think up a new training
regimen so that
she doesn't get left behind.

Before we know it, the day of the Satsuki
Sho—the first race of the
Classics in which
all three members of BNW are
competing—is here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaagh! Just hearing "Classic race" is
making me nervous!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Because every Classic is a big deal, not
just the Derby.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Because every Classic is a big deal, not
just the Derby.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We've trained hard for this though. You're
in tip-top shape. All that's
left is to race
up a storm and take the crown!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin and Hayahide will be with me too!
So I'll be able to go all out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm ready!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Taishin! Hayahide! HEEEEEY!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! I told you, the echo in here is
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
I can't help it. I'm so happy to race
together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand your enthusiasm. We've been
through many races and
are finally
standing on the same track. It's deeply
moving.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I guess...
it's kinda cool that all three of us
made it here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, running together is not our goal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To run and to win... We've given
everything for that reason. It was all
to be
here, on this day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Me too. I've wanted nothing more than to
make it here. So I'm gonna
race like never
before and win this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I don't intend to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are high for the favorite
racer
entering now—BNW
member, Winning
Ticket!

Winning Ticket gives a big wave to her
fans in the stands as she
heads for the
starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are entering the gate!
The first
race of the Classics, the
Satsuki Sho...
begins!
